# Vendored third-party files

These files are copied unmodified from their official sources and served from the app's own origin, so the app makes no requests to other domains and works offline (the service worker in `../sw.js` caches them). Do not edit them; to upgrade, replace them with a new pinned version, update the paths in `app.js` and `sw.js`, the hashes below and in `tests/pwa.test.mjs`, and the tables in `README.md` and `NOTICE`.

| Path                                                              | Component                                          | Version   | License                          | Source                                                                                                           | SHA-256                                                            |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | --------- | -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `mediapipe/tasks-vision@1.2.2/vision_bundle.mjs`                  | MediaPipe Tasks Vision (`@mediapipe/tasks-vision`) | 1.2.2     | Apache-2.0                       | npm `@mediapipe/tasks-vision@1.2.2` (`npm pack`), same file as jsDelivr `/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-vision@1.2.2/`    | `b65acb59b370cd6561afd9d04c29ed7a87e7ed6386922ac1b263af1f1ad06b7d` |
| `mediapipe/tasks-vision@1.2.2/wasm/vision_wasm_internal.js`       | same package, WASM loader                          | 1.2.2     | Apache-2.0                       | same package, `wasm/`                                                                                            | `f2b9c17131ea79716ec6bf07b117a087b2749a6f8a1e2f1f2e77a9382092db5b` |
| `mediapipe/tasks-vision@1.2.2/wasm/vision_wasm_internal.wasm`     | same package, WebAssembly binary                   | 1.2.2     | Apache-2.0                       | same package, `wasm/`                                                                                            | `f5bd25147ac89d506074293ce2675969b10e827180db95a0d9689c2ed80764ab` |
| `mediapipe/models/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task` | Face Landmarker model (float16, version 1)         | float16/1 | Apache-2.0 (per the model cards) | <https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task> | `64184e229b263107bc2b804c6625db1341ff2bb731874b0bcc2fe6544e0bc9ff` |

Only the files the app uses are included: the package's CommonJS bundle, source maps, type definitions and the `vision_wasm_module_internal.*` variant are left out.

**Usage statistics.** `vision_bundle.mjs` 1.2.2 contains a logger that periodically `POST`s task usage statistics (task type, running mode, timing; no images) to `https://odml.pa.googleapis.com/v1/log` (as far as the minified code shows, counts and timings per task, no images or landmarks; not independently verified). The app's Content-Security-Policy (`connect-src 'self'`) blocks that request, so nothing leaves the device; the blocked request shows up as a CSP message in the DevTools console. This is expected.
